license_required.quote: No person may lawfully practice in this state as a certified public accountant either in the person's own name, or under an assumed name, or as a member of a firm, unless the person has been granted by the examining board a certificate as a certified public accountant, and unless the person and firm have complied with all of the provisions of this chapter, including licensure.

issuing_authority.quote: "Examining board" means the accounting examining board.

age_minimum.quote: The person is 18 years of age or older.

moral_character_required.quote: The person does not have an arrest or conviction record, subject to ss. 111.321, 111.322, and 111.335.

degree_required.value: Bachelor's or higher degree with at least 150 semester hours including accounting and business coursework
degree_required.quote: completed at least 150 semester hours of education at an institution that include course work in accounting and business subjects, as determined by the examining board, and has received a bachelor's or higher degree.

accrediting_body.value: Accrediting agency recognized by the secretary of the federal department of education
accrediting_body.quote: "institution" means an institution of higher education accredited by an accrediting agency that is recognized by the secretary of the federal department of education.

required.quote: The person has at least one year of public accounting experience or its equivalent, the sufficiency of the experience or the equivalency to be judged by the examining board.

duration.quote: The person has at least one year of public accounting experience or its equivalent

kind.quote: at least one year of public accounting experience or its equivalent

exams.name: CPA Examination (AICPA)
exams.notes: Candidate must have completed at least 120 semester hours before sitting; examining board may use AICPA examination service.
exams.quote: the person has successfully passed an examination in such subjects affecting accountancy and business as the examining board considers necessary. A person is not eligible to take the examination under this subdivision unless the person has completed at least 120 semester hours of education

interval_years.quote: The rules promulgated under this paragraph may not require an individual to complete more than 80 continuing education credits during the 2-year period immediately preceding the renewal date

required.quote: The examining board shall promulgate rules establishing continuing education requirements for renewal of licenses granted to individuals under this chapter.

hours_per_period.quote: The rules promulgated under this paragraph may not require an individual to complete more than 80 continuing education credits during the 2-year period immediately preceding the renewal date

period_years.quote: more than 80 continuing education credits during the 2-year period immediately preceding the renewal date

available.quote: The examining board may grant a certificate to any applicant who is the holder of a certificate or license to practice as a certified public accountant issued under the laws of any other state or foreign country.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid CPA certificate or license from another state or foreign country and establish substantial equivalence of qualifications required under s. 442.04.
requirements.quote: The applicant must also establish his or her substantial equivalence of the qualifications required under s. 442.04. The sufficiency of the substantial equivalence shall be judged by the examining board.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may lawfully practice in this state as a certified public accountant either in the person's own name, or under an assumed name, or as a member of a firm, unless the person has been granted by the examining board a certificate as a certified public accountant, and unless the person and firm have complied with all of the provisions of this chapter, including licensure.

credential_type.quote: The department shall issue a license to an individual who holds an unrevoked certificate as a certified public accountant

is_mandatory.quote: No person may lawfully practice in this state as a certified public accountant either in the person's own name, or under an assumed name, or as a member of a firm, unless the person has been granted by the examining board a certificate as a certified public accountant

title_protection.quote: no other person shall assume to use such title or the abbreviation "C.P.A." or any other word, words, letters, or figures to indicate that the person using the same is a certified public accountant.

scope_protection.quote: Practices as a certified public accountant after his or her certificate has been revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder has violated this chapter or any duly promulgated standard or rule of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revoke, limit, or suspend for a definite period any certificate, license, or practice privilege, or officially reprimand the holder, if it finds that the holder has violated this chapter or any duly promulgated standard or rule of practice or for any other sufficient cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A member of a firm has committed an act or omission that would be cause for revoking, limiting, or suspending an individual certificate or license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a firm, revoke, limit, or suspend the license of the firm, or reprimand it, if it is found that any member of the firm has been guilty of such act or omission as would be cause for revoking, limiting, or suspending a certificate or license to the person as an individual

disciplinary_grounds.description: A licensee practicing in another state commits an act that would subject them to disciplinary action in that state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person who is licensed or certified under this chapter who practices as a certified public accountant in another state is subject to disciplinary action by the examining board under this section for an act committed in the other state that would subject the person to disciplinary action in the other state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receipt of a complaint by another state's board of accountancy against a Wisconsin licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The examining board shall investigate and may take disciplinary action under sub. (1) against a person licensed or certified in this state upon receipt of a complaint by the examining board of accountancy of another state against that person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certifying to any false or fraudulent report, certificate, exhibit, schedule, or statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Certifies to any false or fraudulent report, certificate, exhibit, schedule or statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding out as or practicing as a CPA without a certificate granted by the examining board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holds himself or herself out to the public as a certified public accountant or assumes to practice as a certified public accountant unless he or she has been granted a certificate as a certified public accountant from the examining board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing as a CPA after the certificate has been revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices as a certified public accountant after his or her certificate has been revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or permitting a firm to practice as a CPA without a license for the current licensure period
disciplinary_grounds.quote: As an individual or member of a firm, practices or permits the firm to practice as a certified public accountant unless a license has been secured for the current licensure period.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, buying, giving, or obtaining a certificate or license in any manner other than provided by this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sells, buys, gives, or obtains an alleged certificate as a certified public accountant or a license in any manner other than that provided for by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to practice as a CPA under a certificate not granted by the examining board or obtained illegally or fraudulently
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempts to practice as a certified public accountant under the guise of a certificate not granted by the examining board or under cover of a certificate obtained illegally or fraudulently.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting by any subterfuge to evade the provisions of this chapter while practicing as a CPA
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempts by any subterfuge to evade the provisions of this chapter while practicing as a certified public accountant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting announcement that a report was prepared by a CPA when it was not
disciplinary_grounds.quote: As an individual or member of a firm, permits to be announced by printed or written statement that any report, certificate, exhibit, schedule, or statement has been prepared by or under supervision of a certified public accountant when the person who prepared the report, certificate, exhibit, schedule, or statement was not a certified public accountant.

definition_quote.value: A person shall be considered to be in practice as a certified public accountant if they hold themselves out as skilled in accounting and qualified to render professional service as a CPA for compensation, maintain an office for CPA business, offer or perform audit services, prepare financial reports for clients, provide attest services, render professional assistance in accounting matters, or sign opinions attesting to financial information.
definition_quote.quote: A person shall be considered to be in practice as a certified public accountant, within the meaning and intent of this chapter, if any of the following conditions is met

value: audit of financial transactions and accounting records
preparation of financial reports and schedules
professional assistance in accounting procedure and recording and presentation of financial facts
signing opinions or certificates attesting to reliability of financial information
methods_authorized.quote: The person offers to prospective clients to perform for compensation, or performs on behalf of clients for compensation, professional services that involve or require an audit of financial transactions and accounting records.

value: audit or other engagement performed in accordance with statements on auditing standards
review of a financial statement performed in accordance with statements on standards for accounting and review services
examination of prospective financial information performed in accordance with statements on standards for attestation engagements
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest service" means any of the following: (a) An audit or any other engagement that is performed or intended to be performed in accordance with rules promulgated under s. 442.01 (1) (a). (b) A review of a financial statement that is performed or intended to be performed in accordance with rules promulgated under s. 442.01 (1) (b). (c) An examination of prospective financial information that is performed or intended to be performed in accordance with rules promulgated under s. 442.01 (1) (c).

education_semester_hours_required.quote: completed at least 150 semester hours of education at an institution that include course work in accounting and business subjects, as determined by the examining board, and has received a bachelor's or higher degree.

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: A person is not eligible to take the examination under this subdivision unless the person has completed at least 120 semester hours of education at an institution that include course work in accounting and business subjects

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: This chapter does not require a certificate or license under this chapter for any of the following: ... A person who meets all of the following conditions: 1. The person's principal place of business or residence is not in this state. 2. The person holds a valid certified public accountant certificate or license from another state that the National Association of State Boards of Accountancy National Qualification Appraisal Service has verified to be in substantial equivalence

value: Subject to personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the examining board and may be disciplined under s. 442.12
Will comply with this chapter and rules promulgated by the examining board
The examining board of the state that issued the license may act as agent for the purpose of receiving process in any legal action or proceeding
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: Any person who enters this state to practice as a certified public accountant under this subsection agrees to all of the following: 1. That he or she is under the personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the examining board and he or she may be disciplined under s. 442.12. 2. That he or she will comply with this chapter and rules promulgated by the examining board. 3. That the examining board of the state that issued his or her license may act as his or her agent for the purpose of receiving process in any legal action or proceeding by the examining board.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: That all attest services provided by the firm in this state are under the charge of an individual licensed under sub. (1).

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: That more than 50 percent of the ownership interest of the firm is held by individuals who hold certificates or licenses to practice as a certified public accountant issued under the laws of any state or foreign country.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: That each person who holds an ownership interest in the firm, and who does not hold a certificate or license to practice as a certified public accountant, is an individual who actively participates in the firm or an affiliated entity.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: the department may not renew the license of a firm unless, at least once every 3 years, the firm undergoes the peer review that is specified in the rules promulgated under sub. (3)

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: the department may not renew the license of a firm unless, at least once every 3 years, the firm undergoes the peer review

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: a person approved by the examining board to conduct peer reviews may not disclose to any person, including the examining board or the department, any information obtained or document produced during the course of or as a result of a review unless the firm undergoing the review consents to the disclosure.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a certified public accountant incident to or in the course of professional service to clients by a certified public accountant, except reports submitted by a certified public accountant to a client, shall be and remain the property of the certified public accountant, in the absence of an express agreement between the certified public accountant and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: A person who prepares financial statements and issues information thereon that does not purport to be in compliance with the statement on standards for accounting and review services issued by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: The department may not renew a license issued to a firm unless, at the time of renewal, the firm satisfies the requirements under s. 442.08 (2) and demonstrates, to the satisfaction of the department, that the firm has complied with the requirements under s. 442.087.

independence_requirement_for_attest.quote: no person licensed under this chapter, and no firm of which the person is a member, may express an opinion as an independent certified public accountant on financial statements of any enterprise unless the person and the firm are independent of the enterprise.
